taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from General features of the cardiovascular system.

words.clue: The innermost tunic of a blood vessel composed of endothelium and internal elastic lamina.
The middle muscular layer of blood vessels that controls diameter and maintains blood pressure.
The outer connective tissue layer that provides support and contains the vasa vasorum.
The smallest arteries that provide the greatest resistance to blood flow.
Microscopic exchange vessels consisting of endothelium only, with no media or adventitia.
A communication between two blood vessels allowing blood to reach tissues by alternate routes.
Structures in veins that prevent retrograde blood flow, especially important in limbs.
Type of capillary with pores found in kidneys, intestines, and endocrine glands.
A venous system beginning and ending in capillaries, exemplified by the hepatic system.
Large-diameter capillaries with wider gaps found in liver and bone marrow.
Series of connecting blood vessels arranged in patterns, particularly in intestinal mesentery.
Large conducting arteries with numerous elastic lamellae that function as windkessel organs.
